notes.title: Monthly demo update - Julienne - Released
notes.content:
It's that time of the month again!

To showcase the new and improved equipment systems in the game, this update has been named [b]Julienne[/b]

Here's an overview..

[b]Reputation is back![/b]
Reputation is a resource gained by preparing jobs that is used to increase your rank as a chef. Every time you rank up, you'll receive a delivery as a reward. This is the new way to find equipment for your kitchen

[b]Equipment abilities rework[/b]
Equipment items now appear around your kitchen in the work phase, rather than a bar on the side. Many of the abilities have been updated, and new equipment items have been added (with plenty more to come). Equipment systems have been ripped out and completely rewritten under the hood, which has created a lot of opportunities for me to add cool abilities that simply were not possible with the previous iteration

[b]Tokens have values[/b]
Tokens are no longer only equal to 1, they have a value determined by their source. For example, all knives now create a token of their associated value, rather than altering dice directly

[b]Improved the heat UI[/b]
No longer tucked at the bottom of the screen, half invisible. Heat will also show a preview based on the jobs you have ready

[b]New abilities for early game items[/b]
Tomato, Cabbage, Spinach, Bacon, Paprika and Garlic have all been updated. Other ingredients are scheduled for changes in the future

[b]New Injured status[/b]
Currently only applying to one piece of equipment but with plenty more sources to come, chef can now become injured resulting in a face being unusable for the rest of the day

[b]Random UI Tweaks and new SFX[/b]
I've been altering and tidying up all sorts of bits and pieces, as well as adding a couple of sfx here or there

The demo is now live, if you encounter any bugs please report them in the [url=https://discord.gg/9cZnbbxV8g]Discord[/url]

notes.title: Demo Update 'Garlic' Released
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Lots of new stuff in this demo, including plenty of bugs for you to find and report 😎

The most important part of this update is the ability to combine ingredients, which will serve as the mechanic for accessing higher level ingredients while you play

I'm going to spend the next 2 weeks polishing the whole game and adding a bunch of different bells and whistles so the game is ready to be featured in the Steam Deckbuilding Fest

Here's the changelog:

12/03/2024 - Garlic Update - 0.7.6.0

Features:
* New game menu with kitchen selector
* New tutorial, can be accessed from kitchen selector
* Added a 'combine' mechanic that gives a delivery when combining two of the same ingredient
* Added an end of week farmers market
* Improved grid clarity
* Shop can be refreshed

Content:
* 19 new ingredients across levels 4, 5 and 6

Bug fixes:
* Events don't replay on save and load
* Shop remembers what items you had for sale
* Made job card update when their slotted dice update
* Solved a soft lock in the tutorial
* Prevented rolling dice at the end of the day appearing later

notes.title: Public Beta: Carrot Update
notes.content:
[h1]18.7.2023 - Carrot Update - 0.5.1.0[/h1]

[h2]Whats new?[/h2]

[b]Chefs are now items that can be moved around within your inventory[/b]
This took a lot of work behind the scenes to get working, but it opens doors for heaps of new and interesting content in the future.
There is only one shape and size at the moment but this will be expanded upon later.
Only ingredients that are 'prepared' by a chef add their recipe to the menu.

[i]An ingredient is prepared by a chef if that chef has it in their frame
[/i]

[b]Added the new Seasoning ability[/b]
The Seasoning ability allows ingredients to modify other ingredients they share a chef with
 - [b]Bay Leaves:[/b] Adds a lot of reputation to other recipes but is itself unusable (an X face)
 - [b]Breadcrumbs:[/b] Changes the recipe of other ingredients to be ONES
 - [b]Five-spice:[/b] Other recipes have a capacity of 5
 - [b]Ginger:[/b] Flips the tier of other ingredients (1 becomes 6, 2 becomes 5, etc)
 - [b]Pepper:[/b] Increases the score that other recipes give on completion 
 - [b]Salt:[/b] Increases the reputation that other recipes give on completion 
 - [b]Turmeric:[/b] Sets the reputation of other recipes to a flat value

[b]Added new basic ingredients[/b]
 - [b]Corn[/b] and [b]Lettuce:[/b] Cheap ingredients with no recipe. Add faces to your dice without diluting your menu!
 - [b]Kale:[/b] Two recipes on one ingredient! Very useful for seasoning synergies

notes.title: 0.5.1.1 - Bugfixes
notes.content:
- Fixed an issue with the tutorial breaking
- Fixed a couple issues with 'number' dockets
- Fixed ingredient tooltips getting stuck to the screen
- Fixed an issue with the offset being weird on various screen sizes

notes.title: Public playtest: Broccoli released!
notes.content:
[i][b]Whats new in Broccoli - [/b][/i]

[list]
[*] New docket types
[*] Food can go mouldy now! Each ingredient has a shelf life in the top right corner
[*] Deleted all ingredients and begun recreating them
[*] Added a new resource; reputation. You now require 500 reputation at the end of the week to win
[*] You receive money equal to the total value of your dice on a docket, dockets have a flat reputation value
[*] Dice that land on top of one another should slide off much faster
[*] Clicking on a die selects it, right clicking deselects it. Does not automatically remove that die from dockets
[*] Improved resolution/scaling issues (will need some feedback on this one)
[*] Reduced file size by removing unused assets
[*] Slowed down the background animation, if the earlier version made you motion sick please give this one a shot
[/list]
